cost_model.fit: whole-pass wall seconds = slope * mean_masked_instances_per_frame + intercept
cost_model.caveat: wall seconds include decode, trunk, restore/RLE/serialisation and COCO evaluation; measured on a desktop GPU shared with ~34 third-party CUDA contexts, so the intercept is machine-bound and the slope is the part the budget controls
